definition: The American College of Sports Medicine is a professional organization whose exercise guidelines were used to design moderate- and high-intensity aerobic exercise programs in this substance use disorders context.

reasons: The definition claims the American College of Sports Medicine “is a professional organization,” but the packet only refers to “Guidelines of American College of Sports Medicine” and does not support the “professional organization” description.

The requested field is “diagnosis,” but the packet content concerns designing exercise programs and treatment effectiveness for substance use disorders rather than diagnosing or defining a diagnostic concept.

The packet supports only that the article used the American College of Sports Medicine guidelines to design moderate- and high-intensity aerobic exercise; it does not support the added characterization that the American College of Sports Medicine is a professional organization.
